scene_description: Two girls are decorating Halloween cupcakes and cookies in a kitchen. There are ghost-shaped treats, pumpkin cookies, a green bowl with frosting, and jack-o'-lanterns visible in the background.

questions.question: What is the girl in green holding?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at what the girl on the right is holding in her hand.

questions.question: What color is the bowl on the table?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the bowl sitting on the wooden board in the middle.

questions.question: Who is decorating the treats?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at all the people standing at the table.

questions.question: Where are the girls decorating?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the stove and tiles on the wall behind the girls.

questions.question: What shape are the white treats at the bottom?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the small white figures lined up at the bottom of the picture.
